title: Cube Pre-Aggregation Build Failures
dataSources: dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow query logs, Cube API request logs and pre-aggregation build metrics (`cube:api`), AtScale engine query logs, LookML validation and metric-definition change events.
app: dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow and Cube query logs and APIs via HEC scripted inputs; AtScale engine logs; LookML content-validator output.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=cube:api event=preagg_build
| stats count as builds, sum(eval(status="error")) as failures by preaggregation
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Tracks Cube pre-aggregation (rollup) builds and flags failures, which force queries onto slow raw tables and degrade performance for consuming dashboards.
value: Failed pre-aggregations silently make every consuming query slow and expensive; catching build failures preserves the performance the semantic layer promises.
implementation: Ingest Cube build events; schedule hourly; alert on failures; investigate the underlying warehouse.
visualization: Table of failing pre-aggregations, timechart of build failures.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the pre-computed summaries that make your metrics load fast and flag when one fails to build.
